title: Build a profile the user can understand
description: Choose a product task, then admit only the signals whose purpose, consent, authorization, and retention contract you can defend.

signals.label: Explicit answer format
signals.detail: The user selected worked examples in product settings.

signals.label: Current session goal
signals.detail: The active request says the user is preparing for an interview.

signals.label: Inferred interaction pattern
signals.detail: Recent edits suggest the user may prefer shorter answers.

signals.label: Private project documents
signals.detail: Tenant documents can ground examples in the user's current project.

signals.label: Purchased demographic segment
signals.detail: A third-party segment guesses age and household status.

scenarios.label: Explain a distributed-systems topic
scenarios.brief: Adapt format and examples for a learner without inventing permanent ability labels.
scenarios.fallback: Give a clear generic explanation and ask which format would help next.

scenarios.label: Answer from a private project
scenarios.brief: Ground the answer in current tenant documents while respecting source permissions.
scenarios.fallback: Answer from public context and explain that private project evidence was not used.

scenarios.label: Draft a customer support response
scenarios.brief: Use the current case and requested tone without carrying unrelated learning history across purposes.
scenarios.fallback: Draft a neutral response from the current case only.
